summary: Tested People Ops payroll/OT overhaul (4 OT categories, hire_date edit, extra_deductions, overtime_only periods, payroll config). Backend: 9/9 pytest cases PASS. Frontend: New Payroll dialog auto-fills end/payment/period_name, switches placeholder for overtime_only kind, creates period & navigates to detail view. Edit-entry dialog shows 4 OT inputs + extra_deductions UI (add+remove works). EmployeeProfile shows edit-hire-date + edit-contract-type. PayrollConfigSection at /people-ops/payroll-config exposes all 6 testids; changing country_code DO→MX persists across reload. OvertimeSection at /people-ops/overtime renders 4-column table (35% | 15% | F/D | 100%) and Log Hours dialog shows 4 separate inputs with correct icons (Sun/Moon).

issues: Auto-generated period_name placeholder is in English ('Payroll 1 - May 2026', 'Overtime 1 - May 2026') but backend generates Spanish ('Quincena 1 - May 2026', 'Horas Extras 1 - May 2026'). Spec asks for Spanish UI (idioma 'es' default). computePeriodName() in PayrollSection.js should output Spanish to match backend label.
Dialog title 'Log Overtime Hours' and labels (Date, Reason, Employee, Single Day / Full Week, Submit, Cancel) are in English; spec UI language is Spanish. Recommend i18n strings.
OT input fields lack data-testid attributes (ot-input-35, ot-input-night, ot-input-holiday, ot-input-100 are NOT present). Adding testids will harden automated testing.

action_items: [LOW] Localize period_name placeholder in PayrollSection.js computePeriodName() to Spanish to match backend output (Quincena/Horas Extras vs Payroll/Overtime).
[LOW] Localize OvertimeSection.js Log Hours dialog labels to Spanish.
[LOW] Add data-testid attributes to the 4 OT input fields inside Log Hours dialog for better testability (e.g., ot-input-35, ot-input-night, ot-input-holiday, ot-input-100).
critical_code_review_comments: people_ops.py: create_payroll_period (line 1715) and update_payroll_entry (line 2032) are very long functions (~250 lines each). Consider extracting helpers (compute_period_name, compute_employee_entry, compute_entry_totals). File is 4723 lines — split into payroll/overtime/employees submodules for maintainability.
update_employee accepts EmployeeUpdate Pydantic model so hire_date validation goes through Pydantic; good. update_payroll_entry correctly normalizes extra_deductions and discards amount<=0 items.
Config 'country_code' is silently coerced to first 2 chars upper-case; non-ISO inputs are stored as-is then normalized again on GET via aliases dict. Good.

GET /payroll/config returns inline defaults when no doc exists, while internal code path in create_payroll_period also redefines defaults. Consider extracting a single _build_default_config() helper to DRY.

auto_include_overtime=False path skips OT entirely and OT requests remain status='approved' (verified). However, in 'overtime_only' kind, ot_query disregards auto_include_overtime — works as designed but worth a docstring.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_OT employees, approved overtime requests, and draft payroll periods. Periods are cleaned up via DELETE; OT requests are linked or remain approved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend routes are /people-ops/payroll, /people-ops/payroll-config, /people-ops/overtime, /people-ops/directory, /people-ops/employee/{id}. Note the route is /payroll-config (hyphen) NOT /payroll/config. Avoid using /payroll/<anything> as that hits PayrollPeriodView with a bad period_id. Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_people_ops_payroll_ot_overhaul.py and exit cleanly. UI in Spanish-default project still has many English labels in PayrollSection dialog and OvertimeSection dialog — main agent may want to translate.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found; all 18 review items in the request verified working end-to-end.
